title: Python Backend Developer
text:
Python Backend Developer
Required: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQL, REST APIs, Docker and automated testing.
Minimum 3 years of professional backend development experience.
Build reliable HTTP services, database transactions, authentication and API tests.
Nice to have: AWS and Redis.

title: React Frontend Developer
text:
React Frontend Developer
Required: React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and automated testing.
Minimum 3 years of professional frontend development experience.
Build accessible, responsive web interfaces, reusable components and keyboard navigation.
Nice to have: REST APIs, Node.js and Git.

title: Applied NLP Engineer
text:
Applied NLP Engineer
Required: Python, NLP, PyTorch and SQL.
Minimum 2 years of professional machine learning experience.
Build text retrieval and document classification systems; evaluate models with held-out data, reproducible experiments and error analysis.
Nice to have: FastAPI, Docker and AWS.
